A $13 Pokémon card sells for $662 in a PSA 10 👀

3 cheap Pokémon cards selling for 22–51× raw once they grade a 10:

1. Armarouge 203/198 (Scarlet & Violet Base Set): $13.00 raw → $662 PSA 10
2. Dondozo 207/198 (Scarlet & Violet Base Set): $13.80 raw → $330 PSA 10
3. Shinx 135/091 (Paldean Fates): $14.61 raw → $325 PSA 10

PSA 10 = median eBay sold price over the last 60 days. Raw = TCGplayer market price. Not every card grades a 10, so check centering first (free centering tool at market.driveyourstyle.net).
